Lie algebras

Source: R/liealgebras.R
liealgebras.Rd

CartanType("A3") (or CartanType(list("A", 3))) is a simple Lie algebra of series A to G. cartan_rank(), dimension(), basic_root(), simple_root(), positive_roots(), highest_root() (series A), roots() (the number of roots), cartan_matrix(), basis(), lie_algebra() and dynkin_diagram() are SymPy's methods. CartanMatrix(t) and DynkinDiagram(t) take a type. RootSystem(t) has simple_roots(), all_roots(), root_space(), add_simple_roots() and add_as_roots(). WeylGroup(t) has generators(), group_order(), group_name(), element_order(), delete_doubles(), matrix_form() and coxeter_diagram(); Weyl group elements are strings such as "r1*r2".

Usage

CartanType(t)

cartan_rank(x)

dimension(ct)

basic_root(ct, i, j)

simple_root(ct, i)

positive_roots(ct)

highest_root(ct)

cartan_matrix(ct)

basis(ct)

lie_algebra(ct)

dynkin_diagram(ct)

CartanMatrix(t)

DynkinDiagram(t)

RootSystem(t)

simple_roots(x)

root_space(x)

add_simple_roots(x, root1, root2)

add_as_roots(x, root1, root2)

WeylGroup(t)

generators(x)

group_name(x)

delete_doubles(x, reflections)

matrix_form(x, weylelt)

element_order(x, weylelt)

coxeter_diagram(x)

Arguments

x

A Cartan type, root system or Weyl group.

ct, t

A Cartan type, or a string such as "B4".

i, j

Indices from 1 (simple_root) or 0 (basic_root).

root1, root2

Roots or simple root indices.

reflections

A vector of reflection numbers.

weylelt

A Weyl group element as a string.

Value

A Cartan type, root system or Weyl group, a list of roots, a matrix, a string or a number.

Examples

ct <- CartanType("B3")
simple_root(ct, 3)
#> [[1]]
#> 0
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> 0
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> 1
#> 
cartan_matrix(ct)
#> Matrix(3, 3)
#> [2 , -1, 0 ]
#> [-1, 2 , -2]
#> [0 , -1, 2 ]
cat(dynkin_diagram(CartanType("D5")))
#>         4
#>         0
#>         |
#>         |
#> 0---0---0---0
#> 1   2   3   5
element_order(WeylGroup("A3"), "r1*r2*r3")
#> [1] 4
